versions.content: EthSwt_GetTxErrorCounterValues returns the list of Transmission Error Counters out of IETF RFC1213 and RFC1643 defined with Eth_- TxErrorCounterValuesType , where the maximal possible value shall denote an invalid value, e.g. this counter is not available.
